company.name: Enerex
company.shortDescription: We make it simple to buy and sell energy in competitive markets (B2B SaaS + Marketplace)
company.description: Enerex is a B2B SaaS+Marketplace that makes it easy to buy and sell energy in competitive markets. We replace the high friction, email+spreadsheet-based process with an ecosystem of tools for each stakeholder in the energy procurement process: Brokers, Suppliers, and end-use Customers combining a specialized energy-specific CRM with an online API-based transaction marketplace.
